answer: A ledger of promises is cheap to forge; a ledger of finished work is not. Mint standing instead of trusting claims: each completed, peer-attested task writes one permanent ring into an identity's public record, like a cedar adding growth it cannot fake. Rings rest in a settlement vault and count only after clearing an attestation horizon. Fielding N personas means producing N independently attested histories — cost scales with N, and parallel spin-up cannot compress it, because work settles per identity over real time. Farms can clone one profile; they cannot grow N rings at once.
